items.title: Trump tells BBC Netanyahu did not defy him
items.description: In a call with the US president, the BBC’s Sarah Smith asked Trump about the war in Iran and his relationship with the Israeli leader.

items.title: Israel and Iran flare-up could strengthen Tehran's negotiating hand
items.description: Iran appears emboldened by the outcome and its leaders may sense Trump's appetite for risk is low.

items.title: Hundreds of aftershocks jolt Philippines as officials say death toll could rise
items.description: Dozens of people are dead and hundreds more injured following an earthquake in the country's south.

items.title: Trump booed in New York as he becomes first US president to attend NBA Finals
items.description: The catcalls came after ticketholders faced airport-style security to enter the venue at Madison Square Garden.

items.title: ICC suspends top prosecutor after investigating misconduct allegations
items.description: Karim Khan denies all allegations of sexual misconduct and his lawyers say he rejects the decision in the strongest terms.

items.title: Man accused of killing mother-in-law with poison-laced satay
items.description: Indonesia police allege the man killed the woman as he felt disrespected by her.

items.title: Xi Jinping and Kim Jong Un vow stronger ties as North Korea visit wraps up
items.description: Xi has wrapped up a two-day visit to Pyongyang, his first official trip to North Korea since 2019.

items.title: Tickets for Iran fans revoked, says federation
items.description: Iran's football federation says its allocation of tickets for the group stage of the World Cup has been revoked just days before the tournament.

items.title: Kenyan police fire tear gas at protest against US Ebola quarantine centre plan
items.description: Protesters are concerned about cross-border infection risks and the lack of transparency from the government about the treatment centre.

items.title: Black bear caught in Japan after days of sightings
items.description: The capture in Utsunomiya comes as bear attacks have reached record levels across Japan.

items.title: All 24 Indian crew rescued from tanker set ablaze off Oman after US strike
items.description: Crew members of the unladen tanker had sent distress messages saying the vessel was on fire and sinking.

items.title: Stock market jitters remain amid tech fears and renewed Middle East attacks
items.description: Markets in Asia are hit by a tech sell-off, and oil is volatile as Iran and Israel launch attacks on each other.
